title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Comparing Categorical and Continuous World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual world models can now generate compelling interactive worlds, but visual realism does not guarantee faithful dynamics. We systematically compare how categorical and continuous prediction shape learned dynamics under both next-token and iterative whole-frame generation. These choices are often bundled in approaches such as autoregressive token models and whole-frame flow matching. We design controlled 2D and 3D environments and evaluate dynamics validity, calibration, and visual quality. In 2D with lossless visual encoding, categorical models achieve higher rollout validity with less training compute, particularly for stochastic entities. Among categorical models, greedy decoding produces the highest rollout validity, while sampling from a next-token model yields the best-calibrated stochastic predictions. Failures in continuous models, such as disappearing game characters, echo those seen in more complex environments. Here, known

translated_title: 超越视觉保真度：比较类别型与连续型世界模型
translated_abstract: 视觉世界模型如今已能生成引人入胜的交互式世界，但视觉上的逼真并不保证动态的真实可信。我们系统地比较了在下一token预测和迭代式整帧生成两种范式下，类别型预测与连续型预测如何塑造模型学习到的动态。这些选择通常在自回归token模型和整帧流匹配等方法中被捆绑在一起。我们设计了受控的2D和3D环境，并评估动态有效性、校准性和视觉质量。在具有无损视觉编码的2D环境中，类别型模型以更少的训练计算量获得更高的rollout有效性，尤其体现在随机性实体上。在类别型模型中，贪心解码产生最高的rollout有效性，而从下一token模型中采样则得到校准最佳的随机预测。连续模型的失败案例（如游戏角色消失）与在更复杂环境中观察到的失败情况相呼应。
tldr: 该论文通过受控的2D和3D环境实验系统比较了类别型与连续型预测对世界模型动态学习的影响，发现在无损视觉编码条件下，类别型模型能以更少训练计算量获得更高的动态rollout有效性和更好的随机性校准，表明视觉逼真度并不等同于动态保真度。
en_tdlr: Through controlled 2D and 3D experiments, this paper systematically compares categorical and continuous prediction in world models, showing that categorical models achieve higher rollout validity and better stochastic calibration with less training compute under lossless visual encoding, demonstrating that visual realism does not guarantee faithful dynamics.
